messages:
Rae (ENG): Hi @Mira — planning to take parental leave in Sept (8 weeks). What's the process for the leave paperwork, and can we get a short-term contractor for critical sprints?

Mira (People Ops): Congrats! :tada: Short checklist: submit the Parental Leave Request form, attach birth/adoption docs, and add your proposed phased-return schedule if you plan one. Link: https://hr.internal/leave-form. Contractors: managers can request temporary funding; see steps below.

Mira (People Ops): Steps for contractor backfill: 1) Manager sends a short Temporary Headcount Request to People Ops + Recruiting (role summary, duration, hours, budget). 2) People Ops routes to Finance for one-time approval. 3) Recruiting posts on approval. Typical turnaround 48-72h after approvals.

Carlos (Manager): I support a 10-week contractor if needed. Rae, can you list 3 core areas that need coverage and preferred overlap weeks? I will include that in the request.

Rae (ENG): Core areas: CI pipelines, infra on-call, rollout QA. Prefer contractor weeks 2-9 of my leave.

Recruiting (Bot): Note: include must-have skills and hourly cap. We usually fill infra contracts faster if we can allow senior-level hourly. Tag @recruiters when ready.

Rae (ENG): Quick Q: equipment — can I take my laptop abroad during leave?

Mira (People Ops): Yes with manager sign-off plus completed Equipment Travel form. If traveling outside listed countries, we'll need export-control clearance (rare). Add travel dates to the leave form.

Rae (ENG): Thanks! Filing the forms now and will DM Carlos the coverage list for the headcount request.

Mira (People Ops): Ping me after you submit and well open an HR case and confirm payroll/top-up eligibility if applicable.
